reproducedFailure.finding: The 80% interval for passing yards covers 56.86% of held-out 2025 outcomes — intervals are far too narrow.
reproducedFailure.mechanism: fit.dispersion.gameSigma is a pooled MEDIAN of per-player excess game-to-game yards-per-opportunity variance beyond the Gamma-implied component. The median zeroed out for every family (all three gameSigma = 0). Rushing and receiving still cover near target because per-opportunity Gamma variance dominates at their small opportunity counts; passing yards aggregate ~30+ completions per game, the Gamma component shrinks by CLT, and the game-level efficiency variance (opponent, script, conditions) that actually drives QB yardage spread is the term the median estimator deleted.

candidate.scope: EXACTLY ONE parameter's estimator: fit.dispersion.gameSigma.player_pass_yds. Every other fitted parameter, the walk-forward chain, thresholds, runs, corpus hashes and scoring code stay byte-identical to the champion protocol.
candidate.estimator: Same qualification as the champion (players with >=3 opportunities per game and >=8 qualifying games in 2023-24 train). Per qualifying player compute excessRatio = max(0, varObs - gammaVar) / ypo^2 exactly as the champion does. Pool with a GAMES-WEIGHTED MEAN of excessRatio (weight = number of qualifying games for that player) instead of the unweighted median of sigma. sigma = sqrt(log(1 + pooledExcessRatio)), clamped to [0, 0.8] as before.
candidate.whatIsNotAllowed: No constant additive interval widening; no per-market post-hoc scaling chosen on 2025; no change to any other family's gameSigma in this candidate; no refit of shapes, volumes, kappas, shrink m, or game-sim heads.

protocol.test: held-out 2025, fully pre-game walk-forward chain, identical scoring points to the champion run (--runs 1000, same seeds policy as the evaluator's deterministic RNG)
protocol.output: data/internal/research/nfl/reports/pass-yds-repair-evaluation.json — a NEW file; the champion receipt is never overwritten (P048 layers rule)

interval80Coverage.why: coverage must move to the nominal band; overshooting past 0.88 means the term overcorrects

frozenBars.pinballWhy: champion 27.019 * 1.02 — the interval may not buy coverage by giving up sharpness beyond 2%
frozenBars.maeWhy: champion 81.432 * 1.02 — central accuracy must hold; the candidate only touches spread
frozenBars.eceWhy: threshold calibration must not degrade past 0.06 (champion 0.0436)
frozenBars.beatsBaselines: beatsRolling AND beatsShareVol must remain true on identical points

decisionRule: ALL bars pass -> the candidate becomes the pass-yds dispersion parameter and player_pass_yds promotion is recomputed by the standard evaluator gates (coverOk under the same [0.72, 0.88]-style band the champion applies); publication then flows only through the existing receipt-driven gates. ANY bar fails -> candidate REJECTED, champion parameters and RESEARCH_ONLY state stand, and the rejection is recorded in the new report file.
notes: Registered BEFORE the candidate was implemented or evaluated. Proof of ordering is this file's git commit preceding any commit containing pass-yds-repair-evaluation.json (the EPL v2 provenance lesson: a backtest generated before its preregistration forfeits the claim).
